title: Tecumseh Products Company Enters Into Definitive Agreement To Be Acquired By An Affiliate Of Mueller Industries & Atlas Holdings
主要内容: Tecumseh Products Company (NASDAQ: TECU) has entered into a definitive merger agreement to be acquired by an affiliate of Mueller Industries & Atlas Holdings. The transaction is valued at approximately $123 million, including the assumption of net debt. Shareholders will receive $5.00 per share in cash, reflecting a 155% premium based on Tecumseh's closing price of $1.96 per share on August 4, 2015. Post-transaction, Tecumseh will remain a standalone business with its headquarters unchanged. The company will continue to operate its global technology centers and manufacturing facilities in North America, South America, Europe, and Asia. Tecumseh will become a privately held company and will be delisted from the NASDAQ Stock Market. The acquisition is expected to be completed in the third quarter of 2015. The deal is subject to certain conditions, including the receipt of a sufficient number of tendered shares in the tender offer. The transaction involves a tender offer and related filings with the SEC.
